architecture_decisions.decision: Keep canonical Project/run UUID identity separate from filesystem authority and materialize source only beneath a server-configured allocator root.
Persist immutable content-addressed source blobs and lineage manifests independently of disposable live workspaces so accepted source remains reconstructable after cleanup, retry and resume.

Initialize repository/template/starter source only through an injected trusted SourceProvider that receives canonical Project/run identity and returns bounded source bytes and provenance, with no caller URL, command or provider authority.

Add protected positive and negative lineage tests for identity/path confinement, trusted provider boundaries, resource bounds, deterministic lineage, stale/idempotent retry, no-change denial, exact reconstruction, different-tree rejection and manifest/blob tampering.

Add allocator tests proving no caller filesystem-root parameter, hashed server-owned paths, forged lease denial, IMPLEMENT lineage advancement, cleanup safety and exact BUILD/TEST/VERIFY reconstruction.

risks.risk: Filesystem tampering could alter immutable snapshot state.
risks.mitigation: Recompute manifest identity and verify every content-addressed blob before lineage resolution/materialization, then rescan reconstructed source.

risks.risk: Concurrent workers could race one run's current-lineage pointer.
risks.mitigation: Use exact expected-parent checks and atomic pointer replacement in this worker slice; serialized integration retains one protected run owner or adds cross-process locking before concurrent mutation is permitted.

risks.risk: Immutable lineage storage can grow over time.
risks.mitigation: Bound every snapshot and keep live-workspace cleanup separate from future snapshot garbage collection so referenced accepted lineage is never destroyed.

risks.risk: A trusted provider adapter can still return unsafe source output.
risks.mitigation: Treat provider output as untrusted bytes and normalize/bound all paths, contents and provenance before persistence while leaving concrete provider authority to #62.

risks.risk: #59 may refine the persistence path for canonical Project/run identity.
risks.mitigation: Consume only canonical UUID-shaped identity in this standalone contract and leave shared persistence/orchestration binding to serialized integration.
